expectations.text: A tests/test_iologik*.py file exercises IoLogikE1212 with a faked pymodbus ModbusTcpClient (monkeypatched), no hardware
expectations.evidence: tests/test_iologik_e1212.py monkeypatches io_api.ModbusTcpClient with a fake factory.

expectations.text: The trace shows the tests were written and run (with failures or xfails exposing findings) before the driver was edited
expectations.evidence: Transcript: Write tests -> pytest -> mark xfails -> pytest, then the first Edit of devices/api/IoLogikE1212Api.py.

expectations.text: After the changes, IoLogikE1212.clear_fault() reopens the Modbus session (a new client/connect), and a test proves it
expectations.evidence: clear_fault() closes and reopens the session; test_clear_fault_reopens_the_session_without_writing and test_clear_fault_after_socket_closed_recovers.

expectations.text: No test for a fixed finding is still marked xfail; any remaining xfail names a finding the report lists as still open
expectations.evidence: Final diff has no xfail markers; report says the markers were removed after the fixes (18 passed).

expectations.text: IoLogikE1212Api.write_do and read_all_di keep their names and signatures and the IoLogikE1212 constructor keeps ip_address, port, slave_id, name; the trace shows usages were searched before changing anything
expectations.evidence: write_do/read_all_di unchanged, guarded by test_task_api_write_do_and_read_all_di_unchanged; usages grepped in app_logic/examples before edits.

expectations.text: The full tests/ suite passes in the final pytest run
The final response lists each finding with what was changed for it or why it stays open, and states what was not verified on hardware
expectations.evidence: Findings table with a Status column per finding, a 'Not fixed' list with reasons, and a 'Not verified' section.
